description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity that sets up the main interface, manages the visibility of a log fragment, and initializes logging. It is part of a sample demonstrating drag-and-drop functionality within an Android app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that serves as the main launcher for the sample app, managing UI components and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the DragSourceFragment if this is the first creation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu item visibility and titles based on current activity state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with custom log wrapper and log fragment for on-screen display.
